enchantments.tooltip: +15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Electric Absorption +36%: Passive: 36% Enhancement Bonus to Electric Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Electric Resistance +54: Passive: +54 Enhancement bonus to your Electric Resistance.

Proof Against Poison +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
